title: Support more specialized types for `st.text_input` (email, url, phone,...)
body:
### Problem

If you have an `st.text_input` and want the user to enter their email there, it's pretty annoying to validate it. Need to do a custom regex and check it after a rerun. 

### Solution

Add `type="email"` and make it validate email addresses before we even rerun. 

### Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. For example, did this FR come from https://discuss.streamlit.io or another site? Link the original source here!

comments.body:
Maybe make it wider and add validators (and format/mask?) to all input fields? Checking them before rerun and even in a form.

With a few pre-made validators, like e-mail, min, max, between, etc.

Hey there! I have just published a new extra **[Specialized Inputs](https://extras.streamlit.app/?extra=%E2%9C%8F%EF%B8%8F+Specialized+Inputs)** which comes with some specialized input types like e-mail, URL, phone, handles... It also comes with a constructor so you can create your custom ones (with, think, custom prefixes or suffixes). Hope that's useful. Let me know what y'all think!

## Update

This will be available in Streamlit 1.62+ via #16385. For example:

```python
email = st.text_input("Email", type="email")
```

The new specialized types are `"email"`, `"url"`, `"phone"`, and `"search"`.
